Memo. No. 422.

Headquarters, Crime Branch,
May 3, 1932.

A letter has been received from the Garrison
Commander of Woosung and Shanghai stating that the
late Inspector Wang Ping (王 斌) attached to the
Office of the said Garrison Commander was assassinated
whilst passing Rue Vouillement, French Concession,
in his private ricsha at 2 p.m. April 22, by armed
assassins. His ricsha coolie was also seriously
wounded. The assistance of the Settlement Police
in the apprehension of the culprits is requested.
Any information, please notify Headquarters, Crime
Branch, immediately.

K.H. Bourne
Deputy Commissioner
(Crime Branch)

（批：See also file D.3650.
Murder of S/I Zao of P.S.B.）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY No. D 3549 Date 2 / 4 / 31）

Translation of letter from the Garrison Commander of Tocsung Shanghai
April 27, 193 .

S.M.P. Headquarters,
Shanghai.

Sirs,

I have to inform you that the following is a
report made by the Acting Chief of Detective Corps, Ma
Tso Ching (馬琢清) on the subject of the assassination
of Inspector Wang Ping (王斌).

"At 8 p.m. April 22, Inspector Wang Ping left
his residence on Rue Lugano Yard in a private ricksha,
whilst passing Rue Vouillemont in the vicinity of Kok
Ung Sz Temple (國恩寺) was suddenly attacked by several
armed assassins, who obstructed his way and fired several
shots at him. He received a fatal wound on the left side
of the head and his ricksha coolie was shot in the abdomen.
Whilst the latter was being removed to the Kwang Tz
Hospital (廣慈医院), his condition was proved to be
very serious. All the assassins made good their escape."

"The late Inspector Wang Ping joined us in 1928,
and his services in the past four years have proved
excellent, and especially he was keen and brave in
dealing with communists and bandits. His untimely
death is deeply regretted.

The late officer left an aged mother, widow and
a young child, who have not sufficient means to meet
their maintenance.

I respectfully submit for your consideration
and approval that circular orders be issued for the
arrest of the culprits and a death gratuity be given
to his family."

In view of the foregoing report, it seems that
these assassins are very desperate in carrying out such
a serious crime as to murder a public officer in broad
day light at a well policed spot. It is to be hoped
that these assassins would be brought to justice as
soon as possible.

I have to request your kind assistance in
circulating this information among your districts with
a view to bringing these assassins to justice.

Tai Chi
Garrison Commander.

淞沪警备司令部司令来信译文
193_年4月27日。

上海公共租界警务处总部，
上海。

诸位先生：

兹告知，以下是侦探队代理队长马琢清（馬琢清）就督查员王斌（王斌）遇刺一案所作的报告。

“4月22日晚8时，督查员王斌离开位于卢加诺弄（Rue Lugano Yard）的寓所，乘坐私人黄包车，当行至国恩寺附近的武定路（Rue Vouillemont）时，突然遭到数名武装刺客袭击，刺客拦住去路并向其开枪数发。他头部左侧受致命伤，其黄包车夫腹部中弹。后者在被送往广慈医院（Kwang Tz Hospital）途中，情况证实非常危急。所有刺客均已逃脱。”

“已故督查员王斌于1928年加入我部，过去四年的服务表现优异，尤其在对付共产党人和匪徒方面敏锐勇敢。对其英年早逝深表痛惜。

已故警官留有老母、遗孀及幼子，其资财不足以维持生计。

谨呈请阁下考虑并批准，发布通缉令逮捕凶手，并向其家属发放抚恤金。”

鉴于上述报告，这些刺客竟敢在治安良好的地段光天化日之下谋杀公职人员，实施如此严重的罪行，可谓穷凶极恶。希望能尽快将这些刺客绳之以法。

恳请阁下协助将此信息在各辖区通报，以便将这些刺客绳之以法。

戴戟
警备司令。

Date April 23, 1938
P. 131 4/38

Subject (in full) Funeral of late Wong Ping, Detective of Sungwu, assassinated
on April 22.

Made by ____________________ and ____________________ Forwarded by Superintendent Robertson

Urgent
With reference to attached schedule of funeral,
I recommend issue of the necessary permit. A band from the
Bureau of Public Safety which will lead the procession will
be on foot. Other participants will be in plain clothes and
will traverse the route by motorcar. As the Chinese
Authorities are afraid that Wong Ping's assassins may take
advantage of the occasion to make an attempt on the lives of
some of his colleagues who will take part in the procession,
I suggest the municipal police provide an escort.

Jhp Robertson
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch

Commissioner of Police.

Sir,
An application for the permit will be made in
the usual way.
Subject to your approval of the proposal, I
shall make arrangements with D.O. "B" about the escort,
for which about half a dozen men will be required.

（批：approved 23/4）

McEwen
O.i/c Sp.Br.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：File No. SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C & S. B. REGISTRY. S. __ Station, No. D 3549 Date April 22, 19 3__. Div 29 / 4 / 39）

Subject (in full) Assassination of Detective Superintendent Wong Ping of the
Soong Wu Military Headquarters

Made by D. S. Golder Forwarded by Tho Robertson Supt

At 1.50 p.m. to-day Detective Superintendent
Wong Ping of the Soong Wu Military Headquarters was proceed-
ing in his private ricsha along Rue Vouillemont and had
arrived at a point some distance to the rear of Avenue Joffre
fire Station, when two male Chinese dressed in foreign clothes
approached and opened fire with 2 .32 automatic pistols.
Wong Ping sustained two wounds in the head which proved fatal,
whilst his ricsha coolie was struck in the abdomen and is
now in a critical condition. After the shooting the two
assasins made good their escape in a motor car (number and
description not at present available).

Wong Ping was employed in the detection and
suppression of Communism and other subversive factions, further
it is suspected that his death is the outcome of his arrest
of one Shiang Tsoong Fah (向忠發) accredited as being the
secretary of the Communist Party in China.

D. S. Golder
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Commissioner of Police,
For Information.
M. Evens
O. i/c Sp. Br.）

（印章：档案编号 上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别股登记处。S. __ 警局，编号 D 3549 日期 193__年4月22日。分局 1939年4月29日）

主题（全称） 松武军事总部侦探长王平（Wong Ping）遇刺案

由 D. S. Golder 制作 由 Tho Robertson 警司转发

今日下午1时50分，松武军事总部侦探长王平乘坐私人黄包车沿武定路（Rue Vouillemont）行进，到达距霞飞路消防站后方一段距离处时，两名身穿西式服装的中国男子走近，并用两把.32口径自动手枪开火。王平头部两处中弹，伤势致命，而其黄包车夫腹部中弹，目前情况危急。枪击发生后，两名刺客乘汽车逃逸（车牌号码及描述目前不详）。

王平受雇从事侦缉和镇压共产主义及其他颠覆派别的工作，此外，怀疑他的死是他逮捕了被认为是中国共产党书记的向忠发（Shiang Tsoong Fah）的结果。

D. S. Golder
特别股负责人。

（批注：警务总监，
供参阅。
M. Evens
特别股负责人。）
